verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI ships a documented GitHub Action feature explicitly providing 'Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions' plus on-demand @gemini-cli assistance in PRs, and community evidence corroborates its code-review quality being compared favorably to Copilot's PR review. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the PR-review GitHub Action (most community feedback concerns the terminal agent, not the review bot) and more detail on review depth/configuration.
